svg.text: Direction-aware normalized scores across the single-episode task suite, with 128ep metadata/raw and Qwen3/Cosmos overlays.
Filled polygons: same 20 public-sample tasks. Points: 128-episode branches only where their public metrics map to that task.
Score radius is normalized by metric direction.
8/20 axes · 128 selected episodes, JSONL metadata/text only
6/20 axes · 128 selected episodes, JSONL metadata/text only
20/20 axes · 128 selected episodes, staged 4430-dim sensor NPZ features; 2 compact proxy axes
20/20 axes · 128 selected episodes, staged 4430-dim sensor NPZ features; 2 compact proxy axes
compact MLP heads over metadata/text features
34,269 windows; centroid/ridge heads over 4430-dim sensor blocks
MLP heads over staged features; tasks 15/19 use compact proxies
separate camera-pose proxy target, not plotted on the 20 task axes
This chart compares normalized metric direction, not identical raw units.
128-episode metadata/raw, Qwen3, and Cosmos overlays are plotted only on semantically aligned task axes.
Raw128 tasks 15 and 19 are documented compact proxies because raw interaction strings and paired video-view embeddings are absent.
